name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-documents
description: MCP server that reads documents as Markdown: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF text, HTML, CSV, JSON and text, in pieces with pages, sheets and slides marked, an outline and tables row by row.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_DOCUMENTS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to answer sessions on at /mcp; unset means the server is started as a program and speaks stdio to its parent.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_DOCUMENTS_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders a session that names none may read, as ROOTS__0, ROOTS__1 and so on; a session at an address names its own with ?root=.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_DOCUMENTS_MAX_FILE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Bytes past which a file is not opened at all, 1024 to 536870912.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_DOCUMENTS_MEMORY_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes a document that was read is remembered so its next piece is served without reading it again, 0 to 120; 0 forgets at once.
